part.text:
ANSWER:
By total count, Friday had the most NYC crashes (338,800) and Sunday the fewest (257,544) from 2013 through 2025.
By share of all crashes, Friday accounted for the largest share (15.9%) and Sunday the smallest (12.1%).
Per calendar date, crashes averaged 499.7 on Fridays—the highest—and 379.9 on Sundays—the lowest.
